parts.name: Root
parts.description: The progress bar. It makes a div with role="progressbar", and it holds the numbers for the parts in it.

props.name: value
props.description:
The progress of the task, between `min` and `max`. `null` makes the progress indeterminate:
the task runs, and its end is not known. A value out of the range is held at the near end.

props.name: min
props.description: The value at the start of the task.

props.name: max
props.description: The value at the end of the task. The progress is complete when the value reaches it.

props.name: format
props.description:
The format of the value as text. Without it, the text is the position in the range as a
percentage. Give the options of `Intl.NumberFormat` to show the value itself, in a unit.

props.name: getValueText
props.description:
Makes the text a screen reader gets for the value. It gets the formatted text and the value.
Without it, the screen reader gets the formatted text.

props.name: aria-valuetext
props.description:
The text a screen reader gets for the value. It wins over `getValueText`. It has no effect
while the progress is indeterminate: without a number, a text for the number is nothing.

props.name: orientation
props.description:
The direction of the bar. It sets `data-orientation` for your styles, and it tells the
indicator which side to fill from.

props.name: children
props.description: The parts of the progress bar.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the element.

props.name: id
props.description: The id of the root element. The component makes one when you give none.

props.name: element
props.description: The root element. Use `bind:element` to read it.

props.name: context
props.description:
The state of the progress. Use `bind:context` to read `percent`, `status` and
`formattedValue` for a shape of your own, such as a ring.

dataAttributes.name: data-complete
dataAttributes.description: Present when the value has reached max.

dataAttributes.name: data-indeterminate
dataAttributes.description: Present while the progress has no value.

dataAttributes.name: data-orientation
dataAttributes.description: The orientation of the bar: `horizontal` or `vertical`.

dataAttributes.name: data-progress-root
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the progress bar element.

dataAttributes.name: data-progressing
dataAttributes.description: Present while the value is below max.

parts.name: Label
parts.description: The name of the task. It gives its id to the bar as `aria-labelledby`.

props.name: children
props.description: The name of the task.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the element.

props.name: id
props.description: The id of the label element. The component makes one when you give none.

dataAttributes.name: data-complete
dataAttributes.description: Present when the value has reached max.

dataAttributes.name: data-indeterminate
dataAttributes.description: Present while the progress has no value.

dataAttributes.name: data-orientation
dataAttributes.description: The orientation of the bar: `horizontal` or `vertical`.

dataAttributes.name: data-progress-label
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the label element.

dataAttributes.name: data-progressing
dataAttributes.description: Present while the value is below max.

parts.name: Track
parts.description: The full length of the task. It makes a div with position relative, thus the indicator takes its place in it.

props.name: children
props.description: The indicator.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the element.

dataAttributes.name: data-complete
dataAttributes.description: Present when the value has reached max.

dataAttributes.name: data-indeterminate
dataAttributes.description: Present while the progress has no value.

dataAttributes.name: data-orientation
dataAttributes.description: The orientation of the bar: `horizontal` or `vertical`.

dataAttributes.name: data-progress-track
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the track element.

dataAttributes.name: data-progressing
dataAttributes.description: Present while the value is below max.

parts.name: Indicator
parts.description: The part of the track that the task has done. It sizes itself to the percentage, and it gets no size while the progress is indeterminate.

props.name: children
props.description: Content inside the indicator, such as a stripe.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the element.

dataAttributes.name: data-complete
dataAttributes.description: Present when the value has reached max.

dataAttributes.name: data-indeterminate
dataAttributes.description: Present while the progress has no value.

dataAttributes.name: data-orientation
dataAttributes.description: The orientation of the bar: `horizontal` or `vertical`.

dataAttributes.name: data-progress-indicator
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the indicator element.

dataAttributes.name: data-progressing
dataAttributes.description: Present while the value is below max.

parts.name: Value
parts.description: The value as text, for the user. It is hidden from the screen reader, which gets the value from the bar.

props.name: children
props.description: The content in place of the formatted text. It gets the text, the value and the status.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the element.

dataAttributes.name: data-complete
dataAttributes.description: Present when the value has reached max.

dataAttributes.name: data-indeterminate
dataAttributes.description: Present while the progress has no value.

dataAttributes.name: data-orientation
dataAttributes.description: The orientation of the bar: `horizontal` or `vertical`.

dataAttributes.name: data-progress-value
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the value element.

dataAttributes.name: data-progressing
dataAttributes.description: Present while the value is below max.
